This topic is part of the OCR A-Level Chemistry specification.

Core Organic Chemistry appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Core Organic Chemistry in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The OCR board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Core Organic Chemistry.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
